```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 45.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 480.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 52.4      # s the probe actually used

targets = evaluate_targets()
summary = worst_target_error(targets)
worst_name = summary["name"]
worst_error_pct = summary["error_pct"]
worst_tol_pct = summary["tol_pct"]

overlay_rgb, pose_note = compare_to_photo(airplane, "front")
pose_verdict = pose_note.split("Pose: ")[1].rstrip(".")
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_error_pct:+.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst discrepancy across all published targets (`{python} worst_name`)]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. Every target reproduces within tolerance (@fig-targets). Planform matches Length at [`{python} f"{targets[0]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, Wing span at [`{python} f"{targets[1]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, and Wing area at [`{python} f"{targets[2]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. Mass properties give Dry weight at [`{python} f"{targets[3]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, CG at [`{python} f"{targets[6]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, and All-up weight at [`{python} f"{targets[7]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. Resulting Wing loading agrees at [`{python} f"{targets[4]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key} and Wing cubic loading at [`{python} f"{targets[5]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. Beyond [the initial reconstruction](2026-10-03-01-can-we-reconstruct-the-ft-mini-mustang-mkr2-within-tolerance.qmd), adding the power pod and folded-box fuselage matches photographs (@fig-overlay, [`{python} pose_verdict`]{.key}).

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **Fuselage section shape: 4.0** — Folded box cross-section.
2. **Power pod: 28x28x65 mm** — Slung under nose.
:::
